description:
UnitySVC runs the official DocuSeal image (the open-source edition) in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address and its own SQLite database. DocuSeal is a document-signing tool: upload a PDF, place fields (signature, date, text, checkbox, file and more) in the visual editor, and send it to one or several signers, who fill and sign it on any device. Completed documents get an electronic signature and an audit trail, and the instance has users, an API and webhooks. Some DocuSeal features are paid Pro features and are not in this image's free edition (for example white-label, user roles, reminders, SMS, conditional fields, bulk send, SSO/SAML, and creating templates from PDF, DOCX or HTML through the API); see How to use this service.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated secret key. The first visit to the instance address shows a setup form that creates the administrator account: open it at once, because whoever submits it first becomes the administrator. Enter the instance address itself as the App URL; DocuSeal uses it in the links of emails and signing requests. To send emails you configure your own SMTP server in the DocuSeal settings. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. The documents and the database are kept for the enrollment while it exists, and are removed from your view with it. DocuSeal is licensed AGPL-3.0 with an additional term that keeps the DocuSeal attribution in its interface. See the upstream DocuSeal documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

features: Visual PDF form builder with 12 field types
Several signers per document, with signing on phones and desktops
Electronic signature of the completed PDF, with signature verification
Users, an API and webhooks (free-edition features only)
Your own SQLite database and documents, kept for the life of the enrollment

SECRET_KEY_BASE.description: The key DocuSeal uses for sessions and to encrypt its stored settings and its signing certificate. Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own (at least 64 characters). Changing it after the first start makes the existing data unreadable: DocuSeal can no longer sign in or open its settings. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
